ja.alt: 花善の名物「鶏めし弁当」（秋田県）- 甘辛く煮たジューシーな鶏肉と旨味が染み込んだ炊き込みご飯が絶品の、大館駅を代表する伝統の名物駅弁「鶏めし」。
ja.caption: 甘辛く煮たジューシーな鶏肉と旨味が染み込んだ炊き込みご飯が絶品の、大館駅を代表する伝統の名物駅弁「鶏めし」。（写真提供：一般社団法人 秋田県観光連盟「あきたファン」）

en.alt: Hanazen's Famous Torimeshi Bento in Odate, Akita - Hanazen's iconic Torimeshi Bento features savory simmered chicken over flavorful seasoned rice, representing Odate's beloved train station cuisine.
en.caption: Hanazen's iconic Torimeshi Bento features savory simmered chicken over flavorful seasoned rice, representing Odate's beloved train station cuisine. (Photo courtesy of Akita Prefecture Tourism Federation (Akita Fun))
